title: ERC-4361: Sign-In with Ethereum
quote: Status: Final. nonce = 8*( ALPHA / DIGIT ). For EOAs the verification method specified in ERC-191 MUST be used... Wallet implementers MUST prevent phishing attacks by verifying the origin of the request against the scheme and domain fields... Sessions MUST be bound to the address and not to further resolved resources that can change... Wallet implementers MUST display to the user the following fields by default and prior to signing: scheme, domain, address, statement, resources.

title: SIWE Overview — login.xyz (Spruce)
quote: Today's login experiences rely on accounts controlled by centralized identity providers, for-profit behemoths like Google, Facebook, and Apple... [the RFP] would enable users to use their Ethereum accounts to access web services instead of accounts owned by large corporations.

title: Spruce begins work on Sign-In with Ethereum
quote: we have already begun delivery on the best practices survey, user research, specification draft, and reference implementation... development will happen in the open. (2021-09-13, EF/ENS RFP selection)

title: Sign-in with Ethereum RFP (Ethereum Foundation & ENS)
quote: The core specification should be decentralized, open, non-proprietary, and have long-term viability... no dependence on a centralized server except for the servers already being run by the application. (Proposals due 2021-07-30 5pm PST)

title: ERC-1271 Signature Replay Vulnerability
quote: in the case that the same address owns multiple SCAs, and the application doesn't include the origin address of the interaction, the same signature would be valid across both accounts. (Affected wallets incl. LightAccount, OKX SmartAccount, Kernel, Safe EIP4337Fallback, Argent; apps incl. Permit2, Cowswap, OpenSea)

title: Blockchain Privacy vs Anonymity
quote: if an observer can link the pseudonymous address to a real-world identity, perhaps through a KYC-compliant exchange ramp, the entire financial history of that user becomes public.

title: Sign-In with Ethereum (SIWE) Authorization — Monerium
quote: authenticate securely using your wallet, eliminating the need for traditional usernames and passwords... title: Authentication — RainbowKit (rainbowkit-siwe-next-auth)

title: The Ethereum Foundation unveils new 'Clear Signing' standard (ERC-7730)
quote: Attackers exploit 'blind signing,' where users approve transactions filled with unreadable technical data... Built around ERC-7730, the framework lets wallets display plain-language descriptions before users approve.

title: CAIP-122: Sign in With X (SIWx)
quote: This work is meant to generalize and abstract the Sign in With Ethereum specification, thereby making EIP-4361 a specific implementation of this specification.

title: Sign In With Solana (SIWS)
quote: The technical specification for SIWS is modeled after EIP-4361 (Sign In With Ethereum) but extends beyond its capabilities.

title: Sign-In-With-X (SIWX) — x402 Documentation

title: Ethereum community has solved a major problem of the Internet: Single Sign-On (Hacker News discussion)
